title: Tablets
subtitle: 本課集中處理 tablets = tablet computers 的科技義項。 不處理藥片／藥丸的 tablet。這個詞的替代表達主要分成 精確產品名稱、觸控描述、手持／便攜式運
description: 本課集中處理 tablets = tablet computers 的科技義項。 不處理藥片／藥丸的 tablet。這個詞的替代表達主要分成 精確產品名稱、觸控描述、手持／便攜式運算上位詞、企業裝置管理用語，以及較舊的 slate-computer terminology。

words.example: The school provides tablet computers for classroom activities.
words.exampleZh: 學校提供平板電腦供課堂活動使用。

exercises.original: The school bought new tablets for classroom use.
exercises.zh: 學校購買新的平板電腦供課堂使用。
exercises.upgrade: The school bought new tablet computers for classroom use.

options.explanation: Tablet computers ✓ — means portable computers in the tablet form factor. Here, the sentence refers specifically to the computing product category. That makes Tablet computers the most precise replacement for this particular sense of tablets.

Tablet devices — means electronic devices belonging to the tablet device category. This is close, but it is device-management language and does not add the historical, umbrella, or touch-interface nuance tested here. The decisive clue is that the sentence refers specifically to the computing product category.

Handheld computers — means small computers designed to be held and operated in the hand. This is broader and can include PDAs, scanners and industrial terminals, so it is not a precise modern synonym in ordinary consumer contexts. The decisive clue is that the sentence refers specifically to the computing product category.

Smartphones — means mobile phones with advanced computing functions. Smartphones are a different product category and generally much smaller. The decisive clue is that the sentence refers specifically to the computing product category.

Laptops — means portable computers with a notebook/clamshell form factor. Laptops use a notebook/clamshell form factor and typically a physical keyboard. The decisive clue is that the sentence refers specifically to the computing product category.

E-readers — means devices specialised mainly for reading digital books. E-readers are specialised mainly for reading and are not general tablet computers. The decisive clue is that the sentence refers specifically to the computing product category.

options.explanation: Mobile computing devices — means portable computing devices used away from a fixed workstation. This is an umbrella category that includes tablets but also other mobile computers. The decisive clue is that portable hardware is the policy category.

Tablet computers — means portable computers in the tablet form factor. This is the precise product label, but it is too narrow when the sentence deliberately requires a broader umbrella category. The decisive clue is that portable hardware is the policy category.

Portable computing devices ✓ — means computers or computing devices designed to be easily carried. Here, portable hardware is the policy category. That makes Portable computing devices the most precise replacement for this particular sense of tablets.

Smartphones — means mobile phones with advanced computing functions. Smartphones are a different product category and generally much smaller. The decisive clue is that portable hardware is the policy category.

Touchscreens — means touch-sensitive display components or interfaces. This names the screen/interface component, not the complete computing device. The decisive clue is that portable hardware is the policy category.

E-readers — means devices specialised mainly for reading digital books. E-readers are specialised mainly for reading and are not general tablet computers. The decisive clue is that portable hardware is the policy category.

words.example: Early slate computers often relied heavily on stylus input.
words.exampleZh: 早期平板式電腦往往高度依賴觸控筆輸入。

exercises.original: Early tablets often used a stylus and had no physical keyboard.
exercises.zh: 早期平板電腦常使用觸控筆，而且沒有實體鍵盤。
exercises.upgrade: Early slate computers often used a stylus and had no physical keyboard.

options.explanation: Tablet computers — means portable computers in the tablet form factor. This is the precise product label, but it is too narrow when the sentence deliberately requires a broader umbrella category. The decisive clue is that historical pen-computing form factor is central.

Handheld computers — means small computers designed to be held and operated in the hand. This is broader and can include PDAs, scanners and industrial terminals, so it is not a precise modern synonym in ordinary consumer contexts. The decisive clue is that historical pen-computing form factor is central.

Laptops — means portable computers with a notebook/clamshell form factor. Laptops use a notebook/clamshell form factor and typically a physical keyboard. The decisive clue is that historical pen-computing form factor is central.

Slate computers ✓ — means flat, primarily pen- or touch-operated computers in a slate form factor. Here, historical pen-computing form factor is central. That makes Slate computers the most precise replacement for this particular sense of tablets.

Smartphones — means mobile phones with advanced computing functions. Smartphones are a different product category and generally much smaller. The decisive clue is that historical pen-computing form factor is central.

E-readers — means devices specialised mainly for reading digital books. E-readers are specialised mainly for reading and are not general tablet computers. The decisive clue is that historical pen-computing form factor is central.

falseSynonyms.zh: 智能手機 ≠ tablets smartphones 通常更小，核心功能及使用情境不同。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Smartphones are a different device category.

falseSynonyms.zh: 手提電腦 ≠ tablets laptops 通常有實體鍵盤和翻蓋式結構。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Laptops have a different form factor.

falseSynonyms.zh: 電子閱讀器 ≠ tablets e-readers 主要為閱讀設計，功能通常更專門。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON E-readers are specialised reading devices.

falseSynonyms.zh: 觸控螢幕 ≠ tablets touchscreen 是介面／元件，不是完整裝置類別。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A touchscreen is an interface component.

falseSynonyms.zh: 上位詞／歷史詞，不等於所有 tablets 此詞可包括 PDA、掃描器、工業終端等。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Handheld computer is broader.

falseSynonyms.zh: 流動裝置 ≠ tablets mobile devices 可包括 phones, tablets, wearables 等。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Mobile device is an umbrella term.

falseSynonyms.zh: 語境較窄／歷史用法 tablet PC 有時特指 Windows/pen-computing 或可轉換式 PC 類別。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Tablet PC can be narrower or platform-specific.

falseSynonyms.zh: 單複數與多義陷阱 tablet 可指平板電腦，也可指藥片；必須靠科技語境判斷。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Context determines the computing sense.
